value: xTrimoGene asymmetric encoder-decoder: continuous value embedding (no binning) plus learned gene-name embedding; encoder = vanilla transformer (12 layers, 12 heads, 768 dim) on nonzero, unmasked genes plus T and S tokens; decoder = Performer (6 layers, 8 heads, 512 dim) over all 19,264 genes; shared MLP head. ~100M parameters.

value: Self-supervised read-depth-aware (RDA) masked regression: 30% of zero and nonzero values masked; input is the raw profile or a binomially downsampled copy (hierarchical Bayesian downsampling, Beta(2,2) rate); total-count tokens T (target) and S (source) supplied; MSE loss on masked genes. No labels needed.

value: Implicit (learned from data only). The T and S tokens are explicit read-depth conditioning computed from each cell's own counts, not external biology. Gene-name embeddings are randomly initialized. No gene graph or knowledge base in scFoundation itself (the GEARS host uses a GO graph).
